First, identify the given date: 03-22-1020 (MM-DD-YYYY) → 1020-03-22.  
Subtract 12 weeks and 1 day = 12×7 + 1 = 85 days.  

1020 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and 400? 1020/4=255, yes, leap year).  
March 22, 1020 minus 85 days:  
March has 31 days, so go back 22 days to March 1 → 22 days subtracted, 63 left.  
February 1020 has 29 days, subtract 29 → 34 days left.  
January has 31 days, subtract 31 → 3 days left.  
Go into December 1019: December 31, 30, 29 → 3 days back from Jan 1 (1019-12-31) → 1019-12-29.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1019-12-29
